ThinkByte: Harsh Pandya, Pavan, Vigarna Ramesh, Raghu Gorrela, Harsha Thota, vinay kovvuri, Charan
Sagniku
Sureshadhi
Rubynathm
Key Takeaways
The meeting focused on reviewing revenue trends, campaign performance, and strategic initiatives for upcoming months.
Key issues included decreased website traffic, reduced campaign effectiveness, low conversion rates, and weather impacts on sales.
Follow-up actions involve adjusting marketing strategies, exploring new campaign formats, and enhancing brand visibility through physical locations.
Decisions were made to boost digital campaigns, strategize for upcoming months, and improve operational efficiency to increase revenue.
Action Items
Speaker 1
Collaborate on meetings, campaigns, and compliance review.
Needs to check if Google has updated the listings to give more visibility to the "get directions" button compared to other buttons.
Update and organize compliance and performance documents.
Will revisit the backend research document tomorrow and provide updates in the group for work division.
Will forward the VCIDEX card to Harsha for review.
Prepare and share plans for December and export strategies.
Speaker 2
Review and strategize for lead engagement and brand promotion.
Speaker 3
Analyze and strategize for campaign performance and budget.
Speaker 4
Share the Excel report on a weekly basis.
Prepare and update reports on campaign and social media metrics.
Daily Revenue Trends
Revenue trends analyzed, focusing on Zomato, Swiggy, website performance, with discussions on daily, monthly targets.
Website traffic decreased, campaigns underperforming.
Low conversion rates resulted in reduced revenue.
Adjust budgets, optimize campaigns for better performance.
Enhance marketing strategies, focus on creative content, improve revenue.
Campaign Performance
Decreased campaign effectiveness, reduced budget, low conversion rates impacted revenue.
Evaluation of current campaign performance, including ROAS, conversion rates, and budget management. New campaigns launched for Tamil, Luminess to boost performance.
Monitor, adjust campaigns based on performance data.
New campaigns need time to gain traction.
Test new formats, content strategies for better engagement.
Paid Campaign Summary and Reporting
Need for accurate, consistent tracking of campaign performance.
Use data-driven approaches to optimize campaigns for better ROI.
Provide detailed weekly reports on campaign metrics for strategic insights.
Weekly tracking, reporting campaign performance with focus on ROAS, AOV, social media metrics using platforms like Google Analytics.
New Campaigns and Creatives
Launch of new campaigns, creatives planned to increase sales, engagement, with emphasis on Tamil and Luminess formats.
Analyze, adapt campaigns based on performance metrics.
Delays in creative testing, performance stabilization.
Implement new formats, creative content strategies to improve engagement.
Conversion Rate Improvements
Focus on improving conversion rates through enhanced creative content, marketing strategies, particularly for Tamil and Luminess campaigns.
Current conversion rates low, impacting revenue.
Continuously evaluate and adjust strategies for optimal performance.
Run new campaigns with engaging content formats to boost conversion rates.
Kitty Party Leads and Feedback
Low conversion rates, feedback quality issues leading to inefficient communication strategies.
Efforts to convert leads from kitty parties with feedback on lead quality to refine communication strategies.
Continue engaging potential leads, refining approach.
Adjust communication strategies based on feedback to improve conversions.
December Strategy and Momentum
Need to build momentum for strong start in December.
Increase marketing activity, launch new creatives to gain momentum.
Plan strategic activities end November for December success.
Development of strategic plans for December to increase sales, maintain momentum from November, with emphasis on new creatives.
Traffic Source Analysis
Website traffic, engagement decreased, affecting revenue.
Identify key traffic sources, improve engagement through targeted campaigns.
Analysis of website traffic sources, user engagement using Google Analytics, Shopify, focusing on trends and behaviors.
Utilize data analytics to understand, enhance user behavior.
Alwarpet and Anna Nagar Venues
Strategies to promote Alwarpet and Anna Nagar as venues for celebrations, events, focusing on millet offerings.
Highlight millet offerings, unique venue features in marketing efforts.
Limited space at Alwarpet restricts promotional activities.
Reuse influencer videos, social media content to promote venues.
Weather Impact on Sales
Adverse weather conditions affecting sales, walk-ins, impacting revenue in Chennai.
Reduced foot traffic due to heavy rains, cyclones affecting sales.
Monitor weather impacts, adjust sales strategies accordingly to mitigate revenue losses.
Cloud Kitchen and New Location Strategy
Difficulty securing prime real estate for physical outlets.
Launch of cloud kitchen focusing on millet lunches in corporate areas, with plans for physical QSR locations to increase brand visibility.
Promote cloud kitchen offerings to corporate clients, expand QSR locations for brand visibility.
Utilize digital platforms for lunch orders, increase market reach.
Competitor Backlink Analysis
Need to improve SEO strategies to match or exceed competitors.
Analysis of competitor backlinks to improve SEO, identify potential opportunities for enhanced search visibility.
Target niche content platforms, free sources for building backlinks.
Identify broken links of competitors, reach out to referring domains for opportunities.
Average Order Value (AOV) Growth
Significant growth in Average Order Value driven by strategic changes in checkout process, improving revenue streams.
Previous low AOV impacted overall revenue performance.
Implement changes in checkout processes, enhance customer experience to increase AOV.
Monitor AOV trends, adjust strategies as needed.
New Brand Agency Collaboration
Collaboration with brand agency to enhance social media strategy, create cohesive brand language, improve creative quality.
Need improved creative quality, consistent brand messaging across platforms.
Hold joint meetings with agency for alignment on strategy, execution.
Develop content marketing strategy with agency for consistent brand language.
Pain Point
Swiggy has not shared any updates and attempts to reach Sonderia last week were unsuccessful.
Had reduced budgets for non-working campaigns, which would take time to scale.
The challenge is adapting communication and format based on understanding the audience to ensure effectiveness.
The issue with the Albert bit is that even if offers are run, they cannot handle the demand.
Limited space availability for running offers due to proximity of Ananagar and Alwar, potentially hindering handling capacity.

Despite actively searching for nearly a year, finding a prime location of 600 to 800 square feet for their business has been challenging due to high demand and fierce competition from various businesses in the area.
Unusual behavior in SEO listings may have impacted the visibility of the "Get Directions" button compared to other buttons.
The discussion focused on analyzing the number of backlinks for specific domains and their competitors.
